releases.notes:
## Fixes

- Underground hiding (hide ores / hide other blocks) no longer requires the
  bedrock-hiding toggle to be on. Before this fix, turning off "Hide the
  bedrock" also silently turned off underground hiding, even if its own
  setting was checked.
- Fixed Sodium support. The bottom bedrock layers and underground hiding
  were not being hidden at all when Sodium was installed, with no error or
  warning shown. This is fixed now.

This release covers Minecraft 1.21.11, 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2, and 26.2

releases.notes:
## What's new

- New: hide ores underground. Turned on by default.
- New: optionally hide andesite, granite, diorite, tuff, gravel, and dirt underground too. Turned off by default, you can turn it on in settings.
- Hidden blocks are replaced with deepslate below Y 0 and stone above it, so it still looks like normal underground.
- You can set how deep and how high this applies from the settings screen (defaults to Y -64 through Y 80, covering the whole normal mining range).
- New optional hotkey that turns both of the above on or off together, without touching the main bedrock-hiding toggle. Unbound by default, set it in settings or Minecraft's Controls menu if you want one.

## Notes

- Same rule as always: this only changes what you see on your screen. Mining, walking, and everything else stays completely normal, and other players are never affected.
- Existing bedrock-hiding settings are unchanged.

releases.notes:
## Bedrock Floor Overlay

**Client-side Fabric mod, Minecraft 1.21.11.**

Replaces the bottom five Overworld bedrock layers (Y -64 to -60) with a fill block of your choice, but only visually. Your real world, mining, collision, and physics stay untouched, and other players see nothing different.

### Features
- Works with vanilla rendering and Sodium
- Toggle with a hotkey or from the settings screen
- Pick your own fill block
- Holes that go straight to the void still show as void, no fake floor over them
- Shows the real block wherever your hitbox overlaps, so you never end up stuck in blocks

### Requirements
Fabric API and MaLiLib. Mod Menu is optional.

### Install
Drop the jar in your mods folder next to Fabric API and MaLiLib.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/exdede/bedrockobfuscator/commits/v1.0.0
